subject: SECONDS-PAST-MIDNIGHT function
notes: Format is the two required words FUNCTION SECONDS-PAST-MIDNIGHT, no argument list (§15.80.2, both underlined). The functionCall alternative `FUNCTION functionName (FNARG_LPAREN functionArgList? FNARG_RPAREN)? refModPart*` parses the bare form; the catalog row (Fixed arity 0..0, IntrinsicBind.Runtime) makes any written argument draw COBOL1504 in the generic arity check, and the keyword-omitted bare name without a REPOSITORY declaration draws COBOL1543 per §8.4.3.2.3 SR2. `FUNCTION SECONDS-PAST-MIDNIGHT ()` is accepted deliberately — the §8.4.3.2.3 SR6 NOTE's own empty-parens shape (`FUNCTION RANDOM ()`), not a leniency. A trailing `(1:5)` binds as a ref-mod of the RESULT (zero-argument function; the SR6 catalog half lives in ResultRefMod). Below --std 2014 the reference draws COBOL1502 (constructs.json row `seconds-past-midnight-2014`). Editions derived from the WG4 CD 1.2 (2009) Annex D.2 item 4 new-function list (kb/Work R28, adversarially verified 2026-08-08), not from the catalog row.
